meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 当你说要迁移旧记忆时,Claude会扫描项目组里的旧记忆文件(如CLAUDE.md、.seed.md),把它们安全搬进统一的memory目录,整理归类并更新索引,最后验证结果。整个迁移会先暂停相关任务并征求你的确认。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等触发词,或更新后提示共享记忆不兼容、组里还有旧格式记忆文件时触发。

say.note: Claude会开始扫描并迁移所有旧格式记忆。
Claude会整理并归入共享记忆。
触发针对该组的记忆迁移流程。

howto.what_en: Claude scans legacy files (CLAUDE.md, .seed.md), moves them into the shared memory tree, organizes and indexes them, then verifies. It pauses tasks and asks approval first.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "migrate memory" or "legacy memory", after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has legacy memory files.

say_en.note: Claude will scan and migrate old-format memory.

say_en.text: Merge CLAUDE.md into the new memory tree
say_en.note: Claude will classify and integrate that file.

say_en.text: There is a .seed.md in the group; migrate it
